data.body: [P2] Snapshot the record before handing it to the worker. `pending` retains the caller-owned record, while the first deep copy is deferred until `exportRecord` runs. A terminal record can reference the mutable handler result, so another thread may mutate it after the durable response was serialized but before export, causing the insight record to disagree with that response. Create an owned copy at enqueue time (or detach mutable fields while building the record), and add a blocked-worker test that mutates the result after `schedule()`.
